content.title: External Assembly | Piecewise Installation to Full-Machine Audition
content.summary: Let large-scale external operators change a stable body piece by piece. Each installation first uses a close-up view to prove the joint, and then returns to the full body state to confirm the cumulative results; after completing the detailed calibration, a complete movement test must be used to prove that all parts can work together.

quick_start.input_format: Stabilizing the basic body + Phased external assembly + Combining close-up and full-body review + Detailed calibration + Complete machine movement acceptance
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original orbital instrument workshop, a palm-sized copper torso stands on a blank calibration mark, and two large ivory-colored maintenance gloves are installed with a two-legged walking base; after the main outline is completed, a pressure probe is installed on the gloves, and the mask is aligned with three scales, without adding any large structures; the automaton takes three steps, unfolds its wings only once, and uses the probe to measure a visible airflow band. All parts remain connected, and are finally completely frozen.
required_anchors: Establish one stable subject, assembly station and unmodified baseline.
Install major components one at a time and return to a whole-subject check after each stage.
Complete all small functional or decorative components before testing motion.
End with one integrated movement audition and a held complete state.

applicable_scope: Let large-scale external operators change a stable body piece by piece. Each installation first uses a close-up view to prove the joint, and then returns to the full body state to confirm the cumulative results; after completing the detailed calibration, a complete movement test must be used to prove that all parts can work together.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.

Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one subject and assembly station spatially fixed while a visibly larger external operator installs components in a deliberate order. Alternate local contact proof with repeated whole-subject state checks so every addition accumulates. Reserve fine calibration for after the main silhouette is complete, then require one integrated movement audition that demonstrates all installed parts together before the final hold.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable subject, assembly station and unmodified baseline.
invariants.purpose: Provides a state reference for every addition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, later parts cannot be attributed to the operator.

invariants.rule: Install major components one at a time and return to a whole-subject check after each stage.
invariants.ablation_failure: A montage of close-ups hides whether parts coexist.

invariants.rule: Use local contact proof for fine calibration only after the primary structure is complete.
invariants.purpose: Separates structural assembly from detail tuning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early fine detail weakens the state ladder.

invariants.rule: Complete all small functional or decorative components before testing motion.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the audition from introducing unexplained changes.

invariants.rule: End with one integrated movement audition and a held complete state.
invariants.purpose: Proves the assembled system works together.
invariants.ablation_failure: A static beauty pose cannot validate integration.

anti_copy_exclusions: cream living room and display platform
beige skirt, western boots, straw hat and ruched handbag
makeup, choker, necklaces, rings and bracelets

instantiations.concept: On an original orbital workshop bench, two large robotic service gloves assemble a palm-sized weather automaton: walking base, folded wing plates, visor, pressure wand and sensor rings. Each connection is shown locally and checked in full figure; the complete automaton walks, opens both wings and measures one airflow stream before holding.

instantiations.concept: In handcrafted clay theatre, a large puppet maker assembles a tiny stage crane from wooden legs, paper counterweights, thread pulleys and a lamp. After each module the entire crane is shown; final calibration tightens knots, then the crane lifts one prop and rotates safely through a full arc.
